settlement.explanation: External production limits reduce the damage ceiling first. Only production below that ceiling is charged.

capacity.penaltyWarning: This is a per-turn commitment. Production below the damage ceiling incurs shortfall damages equal to {penaltyPercent}% of the market value of each missing unit.

negotiation.intro: Private off-market commodity negotiations. Either CEO can make the opening offer, send a counter-offer, or accept the current terms. Either party can cancel.
negotiation.openingHelp: The other corporation must accept or counter before the contract starts.
negotiation.counterpartyHelp: Any player-run corporation, including foreign ones, can be a counterparty.
negotiation.localServiceHelp: This service is supplied within one state. The contract reserves the supplier's plants there for the buyer's plants in the same state.
negotiation.buyerFreightHelp: The supplier's capacity is checked when they review the offer.
negotiation.volumeHelp: Units/turn reserved for the buyer. Anything your sectors make above this still sells on the open market as normal.
negotiation.priceHelp: At most ±{band}% of market price. Positive favours the supplier; negative favours the buyer.
negotiation.termHelp: Leave blank for an open-ended agreement. Fixed terms run for {min} to {max} turns after acceptance.
negotiation.acceptOrCounter: Accept this offer or send a counter-offer.
negotiation.waiting: Waiting for the counterparty to respond.

validation.positiveVolume: Volume cap must be a positive number
validation.priceBand: Price must be within ±{band}% of market
validation.localServiceState: Select the state this service contract is fulfilled from

sectorInvestment.recoveryExplanation: Park surplus capacity while keeping a smaller operation running. Parked plants pay reduced upkeep. You keep the plants and can reopen them for free. Production, staffing and upkeep adjust next turn; supply commitments still apply.
sectorInvestment.mothballHelp: Mothball all capacity or park just a share below. Cold capacity pays {percent}% of its anchored maintenance basis and produces nothing. Normal depreciation continues.
sectorInvestment.cancelHelp: Cancellation returns 75% of the cost of the capacity still under construction. Delivered capacity is kept.
sectorInvestment.strandedOptions: Options: park surplus capacity in the Plant panel, change to a strategy with stronger demand, stockpile storable goods during a temporary glut, or sell the sector. Growing capacity will help only where buyers can absorb it.
sectorInvestment.expansionDiscountHelp: New ordinary expansion receives this build-cost reduction. Founder pricing is separate.
sectorInvestment.rampHelp: Capacity arrives gradually from next turn until the build completes. Existing paid orders keep their original schedule.
sectorInvestment.cashPayback: Charged build cash recovered after {turns} turns in this scenario.
sectorInvestment.noCashPayback: Charged build cash is not recovered within 192 turns in this scenario.
sectorInvestment.bondReference: Sovereign reference: {issuer} ({currency}), {yield}% annual yield at the current market price, {turns} turns to maturity.
sectorInvestment.noBondReference: No eligible short sovereign bond quote in the corporation's currency.
sectorInvestment.bondReferenceLimits: Bond yield is an annual quote reference; plant cash returns below are cumulative. This is not a trade quote. Bond fees, default and future reinvestment yields are excluded. Returned principal is not income.
sectorInvestment.noForecast: A cash-return scenario needs current operating figures after temporary market support has ended. It is unavailable during market support, retooling, or while those figures are missing or stale.
sectorInvestment.cashReturn: of the build cost returned as cash
sectorInvestment.assumptions: Holds last turn's prices, production pace, sales share and costs constant. Assumes existing cash funds the build; borrowing costs and returns forgone elsewhere are excluded. Capacity and strategy changes made since that turn are not included. Additional sales are capped by measured unmet demand; unwanted output still incurs production costs. Includes the construction ramp, physical depreciation, idle upkeep and freight. Excludes receipts from selling previously stored inventory. Allocates today's corporation overhead, including R&D, proportionally; taxes positive income at {tax}%. Reserves cash for replacement. Prices, demand, policies, staffing and competitors can change. Remaining value is depreciated construction spend, excludes transfer fees and is not a cash sale quote. Returns are cumulative, not annualized.
sectorInvestment.deductions96: Over 96 turns: overhead {overhead}, tax {tax}, replacement reserve {replacement}.
sectorInvestment.noDemand: There is no measured unmet demand for this output mix. This scenario gives new capacity no additional sales. A new strategy, better delivery or winning customers could change that.
sectorInvestment.quantityHelp: Type a quantity or use the step buttons. Shift: 10× step. Ctrl / Cmd: 100× step.
sectorInvestment.addedCapacityHelp: Daily capacity added once this order is fully built.
sectorInvestment.staffNeededHelp: Extra workers needed once the new capacity is running. Their wages add to daily costs.
sectorInvestment.reviewLoan: Complete the loan details and pledge consent to continue.
sectorInvestment.financeToggle: Finance this build with a bank term loan
sectorInvestment.financeHelp: Borrow up to 75% of construction cost. Pay the rest from company cash.
sectorInvestment.noLenders: No eligible same-currency lender is available.
sectorInvestment.loanPledge: I pledge this sector to the lender until principal is repaid.
sectorInvestment.loanPledgeHelp: Cancellation refunds and sale proceeds repay secured principal first. Default can lead to foreclosure.
sectorInvestment.contributionShortfall: Available cash does not cover your contribution.
sectorInvestment.loanStartsAfterApproval: The build starts after the lender approves and delivers funding.
sectorInvestment.sizingReserve: Keeps at least {amount} for company running costs, plus one turn of costs for the new capacity. Checks lower sale prices and higher input costs; uses current measured demand after queued builds.
sectorInvestment.sizingFinance: Automatic sizing uses a cash budget. Review loan repayments and choose the financed quantity manually.
sectorInvestment.sizingResources: Automatic sizing for extraction needs deposit headroom, which this forecast does not model. Check resource availability and choose the quantity manually.
sectorInvestment.measuredDemandUnavailable: Measured demand for every output is unavailable. Choose a quantity manually after checking the market.

sizingReasons.history: Automatic sizing is unavailable without current operating figures and a running-cost budget. Outstanding debt needs a manual repayment budget.
sizingReasons.constraints: Resolve staffing, parked capacity, delivery or production limits before using automatic sizing.
sizingReasons.unprofitable: Expansion does not produce positive cash when sale prices fall and input costs rise in the operating scenario. No quantity is recommended.
sizingReasons.cash: There is not enough cash to build one facility while retaining the operating reserve.
sizingReasons.demand: Measured buyers and queued builds leave room for less than one additional facility.

sectorInvestment.mixedOrQueuedDemand: Some outputs have no measured unmet demand, or queued builds already cover the available buyers. Extra capacity can leave part of the output unsold.

tooltips.position: Where the bank stands right now. Each figure links to the tab that moves it.
tooltips.postedCapital: Capital posted from the treasury plus retained earnings. It stands behind depositors and sets the deposit ceiling.
tooltips.deposits: Household savings arrive as cash in the vault; player savings pointed at the bank are pointers, not cash. Only the cash half raises the reserve requirement, but both count toward the deposit ceiling.
tooltips.depositCeiling: The most deposits the bank may hold: the lower of deposit-network capacity and 12x book equity.
tooltips.loansOut: Named player loans plus the household book. Lending earns interest but consumes reserves.
tooltips.rates: Your offsets versus central bank prime, inside the legal rate limits. Pay more to attract savers; charge more to earn, at the cost of demand.
tooltips.capitalStressed: Survives today, fails the stress scenario
tooltips.capitalAdequate: Above the minimum and the stress scenario
tooltips.discountOutstanding: What the bank currently owes the central bank. Repay it to start clearing the stigma.
tooltips.discountRate: Emergency borrowing costs more than the market. The penalty rate is the price of speed.
tooltips.discountCapacity: How much more the window will lend before it hits its cap.
tooltips.discountStigma: Drawing the window shakes depositor confidence. The penalty fades once the debt is repaid.
tooltips.interbankDebt: What the bank owes other banks. Market funding: cheaper than the window, but the lenders can pull it.
tooltips.marginDebt: Central bank lending against posted collateral. Secured, but arrears here draw supervisory attention.
tooltips.interestEarned: Loan interest collected plus any interbank interest received as a lender, last banking pass. Income to the bank, in charter currency.
tooltips.interestPaid: Deposit interest credited to savers plus any interbank or central-bank facility interest paid, last banking pass. A cost to the bank, in charter currency.
tooltips.netInterest: Interest earned minus interest paid, last banking pass. Positive means lending covers the cost of deposits; negative means deposits cost more than loans earn.
tooltips.otherCharges: Deposit-insurance premium and defaulted principal written off, last banking pass. Both reduce the bottom line below net interest.
tooltips.takeProfits: Earnings stay in the bank until moved. Withdraw cash under Treasury, limited by withdrawable reserves.

bankConsole.originationFeesDetail: Household fees in this pass; all loans since charter {lifetime}
bankConsole.originationFeesTooltip: Fees are withheld from newly funded principal. Repayment carries no new origination fee.
bankConsole.feeBottomLine: Net interest plus household fees minus insurance and write-offs

bulkWages.label: Wage multiplier
bulkWages.hint: 1.0 is baseline pay. Set wages for this country and sector group. Legal minimums and negotiated wage floors still apply.
bulkWages.failed: Could not update wages. Try again.
bulkWages.saved: Wages updated for {count, plural, one {# holding} other {# holdings}}.
bulkWages.cost: {count, plural, one {# holding} other {# holdings}}: estimated wage bill {current} → {projected} per turn (change {delta}).
bulkWages.estimate: Estimate based on the last recorded wage bill, current wage settings and active agreement floors. Output, minimum-wage multipliers, union premiums and other costs are held constant. Actual next-turn costs may differ.
bulkWages.protected: {count, plural, one {# holding remains} other {# holdings remain}} protected by a higher negotiated wage floor.
bulkWages.missing: Cost data is unavailable for {count, plural, one {# holding} other {# holdings}}. These holdings are excluded from the estimate but will receive the wage setting.

supplyBoard.title: Open supply offers
supplyBoard.intro: Find a trading partner or advertise what you want to buy or sell. A posted offer is a standing offer: taking it starts a binding supply agreement at the listed terms, for any quantity up to what is left. To change the terms first, negotiate privately instead.
supplyBoard.failed: Could not load or save supply offers.
supplyBoard.full: Withdraw an offer before publishing another. Each corporation has ten slots.
supplyBoard.expiry: Offers expire after 168 turns. Posting does not reserve capacity, but anyone who takes your offer starts a contract on these terms. You can withdraw an offer at any time.
supplyBoard.terms: {volume} {unit} per turn at {premium}% relative to market price.
supplyBoard.taken: Agreement started. It is active now.

costPlusPricing.notReady: Available after a producing turn records operating costs
costPlusPricing.explanation: Prices use recorded operating costs plus your markup. Material costs follow input prices. Cheaper competitors still sell first; unsold output can cause a loss.

loanFees.explanation: The fee is withheld when funded. You repay the full principal.

editorialStance.title: Editorial stance
editorialStance.description: Your newsroom's published position shapes its audience and the politicians it supports. In each state where you run newsrooms, advertisers whose own positions are close to the local newsroom lean pay up to 15% less to run ads.
editorialStance.saveFailed: Could not publish the editorial stance.

propForexFees.preview: Vault cash {cost}, including {fee} fee. The fee does not increase the position value.
propForexFees.explanation: Forex fees grow with the bank's recent trade size and market liquidity. Quote the cash cost before buying.
propForexFees.closeQuote: Receive {proceeds} after a {fee} forex fee. Sell this position?
propForexFees.opened: Position opened. Vault cash paid {cost}, including a {fee} forex fee.

fundBondHoldings.title: Bond holdings
fundBondHoldings.valuationTooltip: Mark-to-market value of corporate and sovereign bonds held by the fund.

ownership.unavailableSplit: Ownership totals cannot be charted yet. See the full register below.
ownership.votingExplanation: Ownership determines the economic stake. Voting power includes supershare weights and excludes unplaced IPO inventory.
ownership.unassignedExplanation: The remaining shares may include sell-order escrow or unplaced inventory. They are not counted as public float; voting power is not attributed to a holder here.
ownership.empty: Ownership history will appear after a turn records a shareholder snapshot.
ownership.missingRegisters: No ownership register was recorded for this holder in this range.
ownership.historyExplanation: End-of-turn economic stakes, based on the shares outstanding at each turn. Missing snapshots leave gaps. Historical voting weights are not recorded. Trades made this turn appear in the current register and activity log.

settingsPanel.intro: Manage the corporation profile, sector focus and brand assets.
settingsPanel.saveHint: Save profile and brand color changes. Image uploads and renaming apply separately.
